The stencil master draws the face with its rack ears (482.9 wide); the ears are not part of the face."},"front-layout":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"POSITIONS ARE THE RENDER'S. It is square-on across and seen from above (the lid shows), so the face is 110.5 px tall where its 1163 px width says 116; rectifying the four face corners (47,311 1210,311 1210,421.5 47,421.5) onto the data sheet's 440 x 44 takes the foreshortening out, and every cage, jack, lamp, vent and legend is placed from dark-run, colour-mask and centroid scans of that 10 px/mm image. The stencil master agrees on the arrangement and legends and is used for those only."},"lamps":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"SYS, ALM, PWR1, PWR2 and GNSS are small bar lamps in a row under the SFP blocks, each after its legend, measured by clustering the legend-and-lamp glyphs: 202.35, 220.35, 238.25, 256.35 and 274.45, an even 18.0 pitch. No document says what any state means."},"mgmt-jacks":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"A 2 x 2 RJ45 cluster: PPS+TOD over 2M, CONSOLE over SNMP, every jack with lamp windows in its outer corners (green and amber in the render). SNMP is the out-of-band Ethernet port, common/rj45-ganged-eth@1; the other three are not Ethernet, so each is the bare std/rj45-ganged@2 with its two windows placed beside it as common/led-rect-sm@1, for: the jack - the family's convention for a lamped non-Ethernet jack. Upper jacks are turned 180."},"model":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"XM-8424H data sheet (telco.com 2026/08), \"Temp-Hardened High-Capacity 4x100G Carrier Ethernet Solution\"; the faceplate prints X-METRO 8424."},"ports":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"QSFP 1-4 are a 1 x 4 row, std/qsfp-ganged@1 at the measured centres (118.9, 138.25, 156.9, 175.45 - an 18.85 pitch against the part's 18.5 width), each with a bar lamp under it; the row is legended 100G/40G. THE LAMPS AND THE LEGEND ARE PLACED AS PRINTED: each lamp sits about 1.1 mm left of its cage centre (measured 155.7 and 174.6 under cages 3 and 4, about 136.8 and 117.9 under the fainter 2 and 1) and the legend's glyphs centre at 146.4 against the row's 147.2, so L61 stays in the baseline for all five on purpose. The 24 SFP28 ports are two stacked 2 x 6 blocks, std/sfp-ganged@1, upper row bail up and lower row turned 180, on the measured 14.33 and 14.39 pitches (columns 198.2-269.85 and 288.7-360.65); the strip between the rows carries two arrow lamps per port, down-up-down-up across each column, as on the TM-7124S and TM-3312. Each column is legended with one pair of numbers, 2/1 over the first and 24/23 over the last; the upper cage is drawn as the first number and the lower as the second (see the port-order gap)."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"2 hot-swappable AC/DC power supplies provide 1+1 redundancy\", \"AC:220V, 100~240VAC | DC: -48V, -36~-72V\". Ordered with one AC (XM-8424H-AC-x) or one DC (XM-8424H-DC) supply, two of either (-2AC-x, -2DC), or one of each (XM-8424H-AC/DC, as the render shows it). No consumption figure is published."},"snmp-speed":{"confidence":"borrowed","note":"BORROWED, NOT STATED. The data sheet lists \"CLI, SNMP, Netconf, USB console\" and gives no rate for the SNMP (out-of-band) port; 1g is taken from the TM-8104's OOB port on the maintainer's ruling for unstated management rates; the snmp-speed gap stays open."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"The data sheet (2026-08), a square-on vendor render seen from slightly above (telco.com 2024/10/XM-8424-new-1.png, 1243 px wide, about 2.6 px/mm on the face; a 1678 px @2x original exists and is not held), and the NetZoom stencil \"BATM X-Series\" (2025-03-07), master X-Metro 8424H (F). No installation guide is public."},"timing":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"SyncE and IEEE 1588v2 (OC, BC, TC) for high-precision timing\". The face adds what the data sheet does not list: a GNSS antenna input (ANT, an SMA, with a GNSS lamp), a PPS+TOD jack and a 2M jack (2.048 MHz / 2 Mb/s BITS by its legend). Direction and format of each are not documented."}},"version":"0.1.0","views":{"bottom":{"empty":"Envelope only.
